title: Sibte payambar salaam
body: SIBT-E-PAYAMBAR SALAAM DILBAR-E-HYDER SALAAM, SARWA-E-BESAR SALAAM KUSHTAYE KHANJAR SALAAM, AAH WO ANGDAYIAAN MAUT KI WO HICHKIYAAN, KUSHTAYE TEER-O-SINAAN AKBAR-O-ASGAR SALAAM, HOGAYE BAZU KHALAM MUH SE NA CHOOTA ALAM, SAQIYE EHLE HARAM SHEER-E-GAZAMFAR SALAAM, GULSHAN-E-ZEHRA KE PHOOL KIJIYE KHIDMATH QUBOOL, AUN-O-MOHHAMMED SALAM QASIM-O-JAFAR SALAAM, KAANP RAHE HAIN QADAM TAUQ SE GARDAN HAI QAM, ABID-E-BEEMAR-E-GAM KARTEY HAIN JHUKH KAR SALAAM..
